allow: PowerShell(foreach \($u in @\('https://smartxsolutions.in','https://www.smartxsolutions.in'\)\) { try { $r = [System.Net.HttpWebRequest]::Create\($u\); $r.Method = 'HEAD'; $r.AllowAutoRedirect = $false; $resp = $r.GetResponse\(\); Write-Output \("$u -> " + [int]$resp.StatusCode + ' Location: ' + $resp.Headers['Location']\); $resp.Close\(\) } catch [System.Net.WebException] { if \($_.Exception.Response\) { $resp = $_.Exception.Response; Write-Output \("$u -> " + [int]$resp.StatusCode + ' Location: ' + $resp.Headers['Location']\) } else { Write-Output \("$u -> FAILED: " + $_.Exception.Message\) } } })
